ValidationRule.description: If the Processing Status field is populated, Major Change, Fee-Waiver, Decline/Cancel or Transcripts sub-categories must be populated as the combination of these two fields is used to trigger an automated process that sends an email to the contact.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND($RecordType.Name = "ASU Admission Services", ISBLANK(CC_Sub_Category__c), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Processing_Status__c))),
OR ( ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Resolved"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Customer Self-Resolved"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Customer Unresponsive") ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If the Processing Status field is populated, Major Change, Fee-Waiver, Decline/Cancel or Transcripts sub-categories must be populated as the combination of these two fields is used to trigger an automated process that sends an email to the contact.
